stories.title: Macklemore dropped from Sheeran tour over pro-Palestine speech
new_facts: New story: Ed Sheeran addresses Macklemore's removal from tour after 'Free Palestine' speech, says shows won't be political.
Mercedes-Benz Stadium and other NFL venues allegedly issued ultimatum to drop Macklemore from remaining tour dates.
Ed Sheeran says removing Macklemore was 'not my decision' but tour promoters'.
Introduces Robert Kraft, pro-Israel billionaire, whom Macklemore says rallied other venue owners against him.
Celebrities and politicians publicly back Macklemore after Kraft had him dropped.
Describes Kraft as 'Epstein-linked' NFL billionaire behind Macklemore's removal.
Kraft's Instagram statement cites Macklemore's 'antisemitic rhetoric' as reason for removal; Macklemore says Kraft organized a boycott.
stories.line: Macklemore was dropped from Ed Sheeran's tour after making pro-Palestinian remarks; Sheeran says his shows won't be political forums.

stories.title: British drama Widow's Bay sweeps Emmys as Matthew Rhys wins two acting awards
new_facts: Widow's Bay wins 14 Emmys, including best comedy, lead actor, writing, directing, supporting actor/actress
Matthew Rhys makes history winning two lead acting Emmys in the same night
Rhys thanked Wales and his Welsh school in acceptance speech, quoted in Welsh
Keri Russell filmed chiding Rhys backstage after he snubbed her twice in his speech
Kate O'Flynn, Bury-born, wins Best Supporting Actress in a Comedy for Widow's Bay
Rhys is first actor to win lead Emmys in drama, comedy and limited series categories across his career
stories.line: A British drama called Widow's Bay swept major Emmy categories, with Matthew Rhys winning two acting awards.

stories.title: Tanker attacked in Strait of Hormuz as Trump signals Iran deal openness
new_facts: Tanker attacked in Strait of Hormuz; Iran cites mines, US says missile then drone hit; two sailors missing.
US manufacturers hit by fresh supply chain cost inflation from Iran war, tariffs, and AI-driven component shortages.
Trump says US is 'open' to an Iran deal amid ongoing Strait of Hormuz flashpoint.
Brent crude hit ~$109/barrel, highest since May; White House aides scrambling; war launched in February without congressional authorization.
stories.line: Two sailors missing after a tanker was attacked in the Strait of Hormuz; Trump signals openness to Iran negotiations.

stories.title: Supreme Court blocks Trump's mail voting restrictions
new_facts: Federal judge refuses to allow Trump's name to be inscribed on Kennedy Center building.
Kennedy Center reports it is near bankruptcy and could close soon.
stories.line: Supreme Court rejected Trump's attempt to impose stricter rules on mail-in voting, and a judge ordered his name removed from the Kennedy Center.

stories.title: FBI chief defends eased hiring rules on bestiality, prostitution at Senate hearing
new_facts: New story: Patel defends FBI policy letting in hires with bestiality/prostitution history, sparking Senate debate.
Durbin presses Patel on FBI response to shootings involving an ICE officer and Border Patrol agent.
Sen. John Kennedy directly asks Patel 'Why would you get into bestiality?' during hearing.
Hearing framed around Democrats' criticism of Patel over sweeping firings of agents who probed Trump.
Patel caught with a 'DURBIN INFO' cheat sheet attacking Durbin's wealth and alleged profiteering.
June memo also dropped automatic disqualification for applicants who stole from employers, not just bestiality.
Internal memo lowering hiring standards was first reported by CBS News.
Hearing marks Patel's first congressional testimony since May.
stories.line: FBI director Kash Patel defended relaxed hiring standards that would permit applicants with histories of bestiality and prostitution.

stories.title: Inquiry finds hospital had multiple chances to stop Lucy Letby before she killed babies
new_facts: Thirlwall Inquiry report has now been published, detailing a catalogue of institutional failures
Managers and senior staff dismissed colleagues' repeated concerns about a spike in baby deaths
Hospital hid Letby suspicions via secret reviews and kept parents in the dark
Inquiry report characterizes Letby as repeatedly untruthful, callous and quiet
Letby serving 15 whole-life terms for murdering seven babies and attempting to murder seven more
Three babies murdered could have been saved had NHS managers acted sooner; names Countess of Chester Hospital
Seven additional babies could have been protected beyond the three who may have survived
stories.line: An inquiry into Lucy Letby, a nurse convicted of killing seven babies, found the hospital had multiple chances to stop her but failed repeatedly.

stories.title: Supreme Court blocks Trump's mail-in voting restrictions
new_facts: New story: SCOTUS rejected Trump's mail-in ballot restrictions; Trump quotes 'let our country down', 'laughing stock'.
Kash Patel says administration working with Congress on 'birth tourism' legislation to circumvent birthright citizenship ruling.
New Trump quote calling the ruling a 'big loss for Republicans', targeting his own SCOTUS appointees.
Trump calls ruling a 'disaster' and praises dissenting Justices Alito and Thomas as 'legends'.
Names the underlying case, USPS v. California, and clarifies SCOTUS denied a stay leaving injunctions intact.
New Trump quote: 'these are not the people I interviewed' about his SCOTUS picks.
Alito's dissent quote calling the majority's refusal 'incorrect' and the challenge a 'Hail Mary'.
stories.line: Supreme Court rejected Trump administration orders to restrict mail-in voting; Trump called the decision a loss for Republicans.
